system.description: You drain all colour and light from a 20' radius at a point within 30', leaving only grey dread. Those inside hear every lie they ever told, whispered.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, 2x damage, and the conditions last d4 rounds.
outcomes.success: Every creature in the area takes d8 damage and is Blinded and Slowed until the end of its next turn.
outcomes.ruin: You hear your own lies: you are Stupefied until the end of your next turn. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
